Hear from preeminent experts at Purdue University about the most recent scientific issues or relevant topics being studied and tested at Purdue. As a top public research institution, Purdue is developing practical solutions to today’s toughest challenges, delivering world-changing research and out-of-this-world discovery. 

See how Purdue University never stops in pursuit of the next giant leap: youtube.com/purdue.
